A friend and I have been trying to build out a big list of fights to kind of play through the history of the multiverse.  So having the list of when all the books really came out and any info on what happened in there would be so useful.

There are a lot of places where fights are very hard to place because of inconsistancys with book ordering or characters being pictured in books they are not supposed to be in.  

The southwest sentinals in particular are just so screwed up on the art.
